infoqArticles.description: Uber has built an MCP Gateway to standardize how AI agents discover and invoke internal services across more than 800 MCP servers and 5,000 tools. The gateway separates tool registration from runtime execution and includes automated API discovery, access controls, sensitive data redaction, incremental tool discovery through Omni MCP, and response filtering. By Leela Kumili
infoqArticles.author: Leela Kumili

infoqArticles.title: Article: Systemic Approach to Memory, Knowledge, and Context in Agentic AI Architectures
infoqArticles.description: The article argues that reliable agentic AI architecture depends on a context engine that selects, injects, compresses, and expires information before it reaches the model. It separates context, memory, and knowledge, and recommends tiered memory, curated knowledge, and token budgeting. It also covers common anti-patterns, such as context stuffing and stale data loops, with mitigations. By Adi Pol
infoqArticles.author: Adi Polak

infoqArticles.title: Podcast: Educating an Architect: A Conversation with Luca Mezzalira
